snippet.title: Shadow's Grove Cinematic Trailer | Fenris Games 2024
snippet.description:
This is the trailer for Shadow's Grove, Fenris Games' capstone video game from DigiPen's junior/senior game project course. I composed all the music and created a large portion of the SFX in game as well while working as Audio Lead for the team. The trailer contains a small medley of the main in-game tracks. Hope you enjoy!

We are aiming to publish to Steam during summer 2025.

Will likely re-upload this in a few months! There have been many nice art updates since we made this for the final project submission.
